Full rewrite (~955 lines to ~230). Removed: all tests that drove a real Google success/rollback/race/nonce/cancellation/error-mapping path through HTTP (that whole branch is now unreachable — parseSocialProvider throws before any of it runs). Added: an unrecognized-provider check (unchanged behavior, kept for regression) plus two symmetric describe blocks — 'Google OAuth remains disabled on the public surface, even with a fully working client wired via DI' (new) mirroring the pre-existing 'Facebook OAuth remains disabled...' block — each DI-overrides its client with a fully working fake and proves start/callback still redirect reason=unsupported_provider, set no cookie, never call exchangeCodeForProfile, and create no identity. Ran for real against live Postgres today: `npx jest --config ./test/jest-e2e.json apps/api/test/oauth-flow.e2e-spec.ts` -> 5/5 passed (1 unrecognized-provider + 2 Google + 2 Facebook), log lines confirm reason=unsupported_provider for google/start, google/callback, facebook/start, facebook/callback. The state/nonce/CSRF/provisioning/rollback/race assertions this file used to make through Google's HTTP path are still made, at the unit level, by oauth-state.helper.spec.ts (5), oauth-login.use-case.spec.ts (6) and google-oauth.client.spec.ts (20) — all 3 files unchanged today, 38/38 passing (verified this cycle, see test_matrix).
